snippet.title: Ablahshikar - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Ablahshikar is a turn-based ASCII salvage-survival game adrift on the Candle Sea. Bound to a worn terminal of bone-white and brass, you must strip wrecks and tear organs direct from rival vessels. Graft severed parts onto your keel to rebuild a failing warship into a doomed chimera.

-
🖤 A Solo Project by Samekh Meryuiet (Amurdat Phantasmatoria)
🔊 Audio & Narrative Design by Briar Soundworks
🎙️ Voice Performances:
• Seamus Bryner
• Caitlin Williams
• Samekh Meryuiet (Vocal SFX & OST Vocals)

🏷️ Price: $4.99 USD
🎮 Wishlist Ablahshikar on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4952800/Ablahshikar/
